commit_message:
[VMVX] Added math.fma to vm.fma lowering (#24915)

There was no lowering from math.fma to vm.fma. This patch adds one.

Vector types for ternary conversions need to be supported as well:
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24937

`Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5`

Signed-off-by: Ayokunle Amodu
[ayokunle321@gmail.com](mailto:ayokunle321@gmail.com)
